title: What Do You Drink While You Work?
why_read: A whimsical personal essay matching coffee orders to fictional characters, with no technical content relevant to software engineers.
analysis: This piece is a lighthearted creative writing exercise connecting beverage choices to character traits in a fiction series, with no engineering, programming, or technical substance whatsoever.
